messages:
marta: Heads-up — scheduling a NIC firmware rolling upgrade in az17 (2025-11-12 02:00–05:00 UTC). We'll do soft node reboots + cordons in small cohorts. Expect ~15% capacity reduction per cohort for ~30–45m. Canary first.
sam: Which pools in az17 are most impacted? any critical customers?
marta: Streaming-burst pool + a few mid-tier ML tenants. We're planning a 5% traffic split to us-east2 as fallback during the window.
jia: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pulls/1245 — adds qps-weighted scheduler knob and a KV-prefix preheat job. Also includes safer drain hooks.
ryan: Can we pre-warm the KV cache and prefix cache before we flip traffic? Would reduce tail latency during reboots.
marta: Yes — run preheat job ~30m before cohort drains. Steps below.
ryan: Example preheat job (run as infra-admin):
```
kubectl -n infra run kv-preheat --image=redwood/kv-preheat:prod -- /bin/preheat --prefixes="/models/qna,/embeds/"
```
marta: Canary plan: 2 nodes (az17a) at 02:00 -> wait 15m health -> proceed cohorts of 6 nodes sequentially across az17b/c. Abort criteria: >5% errors or 150ms p90 increase sustained for 5m. If abort, immediate 100% traffic shift to us-east2 fallback pool.
leila: I will own customer comms for enterprise tenants. Draft ready, will post to status page 1h before window.
oncall-bot: @oncall scheduled maintenance: NIC firmware rolling upgrade in az17 on 2025-11-12 02:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.status/maintenance/az17-nic-fw
ops-bot: Temporary capacity reservation created: +50 GPU-hours in us-east2 (hot spare). Estimated cost: ~$3.2k. Billing notified.
marta: Also note: for a few high-memory tenants we may route to quantized model variants (q4_0) during window to preserve throughput. QA sign-off = @sam
sam: OK — I reviewed q4_0 fallback latency/quality matrix. Acceptable for 2 tenants flagged. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started on az17a at 02:00 (canary nodes: node-az17a-021, node-az17a-022). Health: initial checks OK.
marta: Draining command we use (soft drain):
```
kubectl drain node-az17a-021 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
jia: Reminder: update Circuit Breaker policy in envoy for the canary split (5% -> 100% if abort). I pushed a config patch.
ryan: After canary, schedule quick perf replay against synthetic workload for 10m to validate KV warming.
leila: Customer comms queued. I'll ping legal for regulated-tenants note.
marta: If no issues at +15m we proceed. If abort, roll back within 10m and trigger postmortem-runbook. Keep this thread for ops notes during window.
sam: Acked. I'll be oncall for the window.
leila: Ack — posting comms and monitoring channels set up. :white_check_mark:
